pick.headline: SAS storms the Iranian Embassy in London, ending the siege
pick.fbis: The South Asia Daily Report of May 6, 1980, carried Tehran Domestic Service on the explosion and fire at the Iranian Embassy in London as police entered, and President Bani-Sadr claiming "victory."

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 089, 6 May 1980
evidence.snippet: …ehran Domestic Service in Persian 1945 GMT 5 May 80 {Text ] According to foreign news agency reports, the Iranian Embassy in London caught fire after an explosion tonight. According to AFP, following an explosion in the Iranian Embassy in London fire broke out on the second and third floor of the building and fire is shooting out from the third flour. alternates.headline: Crimean parliament declares independence
alternates.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of May 6, 1992, summarized Radio Rossii on the Crimean Supreme Soviet adopting an act proclaiming independence, a referendum planned for August 2, and Kravchuk denouncing it.
